notes.title: Demo v2 Big Update Announcement!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604773/4b4905f0b7ba5acefc46e5c794135c70f37f22f1.jpg"]

This demo is intended to showcase polished combat and core base mechanics.



If everything goes according to plan, we will be releasing more updates soon.



The following is present in demo v2:  


Mechanics:
Move tower

Storage & Inventory

Tower storage

Tower eqquipment

Fuse shards

Upgrades

Craft towers

Store (Only sell)

Minimap

Monster bar

Monster routes indicator

Drop system

Rift system

Character data menu

Victory achievements

Save & Load system


Towers:
 Balanced Metal Tower


Weapon:
 Sharp Shot



If you find any bugs, please let us know so we can fix them in order.



The second map was not included this time due to code compatibility issues for which we will have to redo part of it.


Stay tuned and wishlist now!

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604773/4b4905f0b7ba5acefc46e5c794135c70f37f22f1.jpg

This demo is intended to showcase some of the core combat mechanics.

We will be participating in Next Fest in June 2025.

If everything goes according to plan, we will release a more complete demo before Next Fest. If we can't make it in time, we will participate with this demo.

The following is present in this demo:

Mechanics:

 Build Towers
 Destroy Towers
 Repair Towers
 Interact whit Obstacles
 Map Waves
 Mana Cycle
 Tolerance Cycle


Towers:

 Offensive Plant Tower (Single Shot)
 Mitigation Wood Tower (Snipe Shot)
 Defensive Stone Tower (Continuous Shot)
 Armored Metal Tower   (Fire Shot)


Map:

 1 Mountain Map, difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard


Enemies:

 Basic Melee
 Basic Ranged
 Destroyer Melee
 Flying Melee


There is no relevant data to be saved on this demo, so the save system will only store system options data.

If you find any bugs, please let us know so we can fix them in order.

The drop, crafting, and upgrade systems will be available in the next demo, as well as a new map and much more.

Stay tuned and wishlist now!
